# Plan snapshots (generated by Porter)

Byte-identical mirrors of Approved Metra-product Cursor plan leaves (and index-driven copies). **Never hand-edit** these files - edit the source leaf and re-run Porter.

Tracked in git after `.\metra.ps1 porter publish` + commit so cloud clones see them. `manifest.json` and handoff machine state stay gitignored.

Regenerate:

```powershell
.\metra.ps1 porter refresh
# or: pwsh -File ..\scripts\Invoke-MetraPorter.ps1
```

See `../README.md` and `../../docs/playbooks/project-lane.md`.
